verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own feedback widget lets a user mark up a screenshot of the screen and submit it. The submission then becomes an intention whose agent reads it and proposes tasks, "so the model fixes the right thing." That is a real screenshot-to-agent path, but it is a widget flow for end-user feedback, not a documented way for a developer to attach a marked-up screenshot or design mockup directly to a task. missing for 10: developer-side attachment of images or mockups to tasks via CLI/MCP/UI, evidence that the image is carried into the task contract the coding agent receives, mockup (non-screenshot) support, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change

citations.quote: Pressing the control opens a box where a user can write what went wrong, mark up a screenshot of the screen they are looking at, and send.
The widget adds the page, its metadata, and an optional screenshot, so the model fixes the right thing.
its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
